name: Natural Haircare By Kathy
addr: 718 N Cherokee Ave, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: Kathy is an incredibly intuitive hair dresser. I trust her completely with my hair care and always emerge feeling beautiful. Her cuts last and grow out naturally and maintain a wonderful shape throughout the growth process. Color looks natural and also grows out very well. I listen to her input for guidance and we work together to create my look.
